author: n. a. sauceda
title: Florida Panthers announce 2026-27 dance team auditions for July in Davie
text:
The Florida Panthers announced on June 10 that auditions for the 2026-27 Dance Team will be held on Saturday, July 11, at NSU Rick Case Arena in Davie. Registration begins at 8 a.m. Eastern Time.
The Dance Team, presented by L’ange, is looking for dancers who are passionate, high-energy, and versatile. Candidates should demonstrate professionalism, reliability, and a commitment to representing the organization with integrity both during games and within the South Florida community.
The audition process will start with Open Call Auditions on July 11. Those selected from this round will move on to a four-day bootcamp from July 13 through July 16. The process concludes with a Final Audition Performance scheduled for July 19.
In preparation for auditions, dance team preparation classes are available ahead of time on June 17, June 25, July 1, and July 9 at Performance Edge Dance Complex in Sunrise. Each class costs $25 and begins at 7 p.m.
For more information or to register for auditions or prep classes, interested individuals can visit FloridaPanthers.com/Dance.
